screenshots.notes: Developer diagnostics separates runtime ownership and redacted JSON into rounded cards; keyboard focus is visible on the disclosure.
At 760px diagnostics metrics reflow to two columns; redacted JSON stays inside its card with visible disclosure focus.
Dark appearance settings show three equal theme previews, aligned code previews and compact size controls.
Light narrow appearance panel keeps all three theme choices in one row; preview text and size controls fit the panel.
Dark automation list presents counters, a single paused entry and distinct create/pause actions with rounded surfaces.
Narrow automation list wraps counter labels and retains the create action and paused entry without horizontal clipping.
Automation receipt groups summary, prior result, run facts and usage; existing keyboard focus remains visible.
Narrow receipt reflows facts and usage vertically and moves the rerun action under the title; reading order remains clear.
Dark automation editor has a full-width task field and separate plan card; workspace text stays subordinate.
Light narrow editor contains the task field and frequency selector; long workspace context is truncated instead of overflowing.
Classic dark chat contains the local image preview and renamed-file reference; task strip and composer stay aligned.
Classic light narrow chat retains the image preview, file link, task strip and composer without horizontal overflow.
Dark image lightbox centers the image with a compact SVG toolbar and distinct close action; background is dimmed.
Light narrow image lightbox fits both image and toolbar in the viewport and preserves visible keyboard focus.
Dark artifact review shows renamed file, small change counts and a readable inline diff inside rounded cards.
Light narrow artifact review preserves filename, change counts and wrapped diff presentation within its panel.
Dark diff popup stays beneath its trigger and shows added/removed lines with distinct tint and keyboard focus.
Light narrow diff popup fits under its trigger; line content and change colors are readable without spilling into another panel.
Independent agent start, problem, result and verifier-start events appear as compact named rows between main Bot messages.
Agent detail opens in the right drawer with task name and main Bot ownership; process events remain visible in conversation.
At 760px agent activity rows and the main Bot bubble fit the narrow conversation, with distinct SVG identities.
Narrow agent detail drawer states that the main Bot follows up and offers a conversation link; technical task information is folded.
Quick chat has only Bot, model and effort selectors plus the right send button; native transparency is not captured in PNG.
Light quick chat keeps three compact selectors with no Project or Agent mode; native-background capture limitation is recorded.
Reply details separates associated work and named sources into cards with timestamps; no numbered evidence dump.
File source names README.md and displays saved content; technical disclosure starts closed and return navigation is clear.
History source shows the read-only familiarity task and its blocked result inside the saved-content card.
Unavailable evidence explains that the source remains but details were not saved; NOT_FOUND is hidden by closed diagnostics.
760 light evidence panel wraps the missing-content explanation within the drawer, keeping Back and Close above it.
Wide pending reply, background work and composer share a left edge; stop remains visible and replies fit the conversation column.
Docked light pending progress and composer stay aligned in the narrower column; preparation card fits the side panel.
760 light pending progress, work and composer fit horizontally; keyboard-focused Details has a visible outline.
Dark history groups Today, Yesterday and last seven days, with search and Close above and a 48-item count below.
Light history keeps date groups and right timestamps, a gentle selected row background and no clipped navigation.
History preview names the selected conversation, separates user and Bot content and places explicit Bot continuation controls below.
Large-text narrow history keeps readable title groups, search focus and a fixed count while the list scrolls below.
Before dark choice send, two response options sit below the Bot question, with a stable composer below the task row.
After dark choice send, the chosen option is a right user bubble with one receipt; Bot response and bubble-edge Details remain below.
760 light choice screen wraps two options below the question without clipping or colliding with the composer.
760 light after choice keeps one right-aligned user reply and one tinted Bot response; selected controls are gone.
Dark updater modal names candidate RC99, current RC11 and Update/Later actions; content is contained and the background dims.
After dark updater dismissal, the main screen returns and actual 42 percent progress sits in the bottom-left version footer.
760 light updater modal fits with both actions visible and readable content; synthetic current-version fixture is distinguishable.
760 light post-update view keeps the horizontal 42 percent footer progress beside the settings area without overflow.
Narrow dark footer separates settings from RC11 version and places a short progress bar plus 42 percent beneath version.
Loading task drawer names the task and recent progress, preserves Bot explanation and offers cancellation and return actions.
Unavailable task report keeps current execution state, cancellation and the Bot explanation; a Retry action explains failed loading.
Stale task report retains the previous readable content while the current task says queued and a refresh failure is explained below.
Dark streaming conversation keeps two separated tinted paragraphs, a progress label beneath and Details at the latest bubble edge.
Light streaming conversation retains the same two paragraphs and left alignment with composer; status is outside the bubbles.
Completed dark turn keeps three public progress paragraphs and a final conclusion card, without a live spinner or lost narration.
Completed light turn keeps paragraph spacing and a readable final list; Details follows the final bubble instead of the full column.
Reply drawer groups real file reading and related work; README.md and a redacted argument are contained in the process card.
Main task note is visible as a complete conversation bubble; the clipped technical summary from task cards is not the only report.
Follow-up draft preserves an embedded task reference above a concrete progress question, with send and model controls visible.
Waiting task detail states the concrete decision, offers an explicit conversation destination and keeps Cancel available.
The main conversation shows the same concrete task question and a keyboard-focused choice below it, rather than forcing card acceptance.
Running task detail separates latest progress, next-step ownership and the Bot explanation; cancellation is directly available.
Waiting detail explicitly labels follow-up, keeps Cancel and makes the Bot conversation the next-step destination.
Accepted detail displays accepted in heading and latest-progress card, removes cancellation and permits further conversation questions.
Failed detail states incomplete failure rather than success, while retaining Bot ownership and the last explanation.
Long-title 1280 dark detail wraps task goal in two lines with Cancel, current wait and next action beneath.
Long-title 1280 light detail keeps the same clear current wait and contained explanation, with no raw internal IDs by default.
760 dark long task title and next-step copy wrap inside the narrow drawer; report navigation remains reachable.
760 light long task detail keeps readable sections and an explicit full-conversation destination; metadata starts collapsed.
Running reply details offers task details and cancellation alongside named sources, keeping task and evidence separate.
Waiting task in main chat and drawer both offer direct cancellation; question is visible without requiring another generic follow-up.
760 light waiting drawer shows contained task question, Cancel and four named sources; no horizontal overflow.
Bot overview separates identity, bound folder, one active task and model policy in a compact sidebar.
Memory tab shows category/trust/state filters and individually contained saved memories with explicit edit and revoke actions.
Ended reply process lists named query/read/view/send activities with closed technical disclosures; public answer and options remain in chat.
Failed cancellation shows an explicit retry explanation in both the waiting card and related-task drawer, with Cancel still available.
Successful cancellation removes the follow-up card from active work, shows cancelled in related history and leaves the unrelated running task.
760 light task details exposes a direct Cancel button before the wait description, with the task report still readable.
Long failure remains a short readable Bot bubble on narrow dark chat; Details contains raw diagnostics rather than flooding the body.
Docked light error puts the lengthy provider record in a bounded wrapping sidebar, keeping normal chat and composer readable.
Wide background work and composer share edges; the work row remains compact and model/effort/send controls are grouped below.
760 light background row and expanded row align to the composer; SVG terminal/disclosure indicators fit without text-glyph icons.
1280 dark image-recognition setting separates label/help from the selected fallback model and channel on the right.
1280 light image-recognition setting keeps the same compact aligned row with a subdued explanation and SVG navigation.
760 dark image fallback row retains complete label and model/channel text inside the narrow setting width.
760 light fallback setting fits the two-level label/help and model/channel groups without clipping or a bright native select.
Providers screen shows one connected service and two models; image recognition remains a separate compact row below the service.
Expanded image fallback uses a contained model selector below the highlighted row, without a white native control or clipped labels.
Empty 1280 dark composer separates editable space from plus/model/effort/send controls in a single bottom row.
Empty light composer keeps subdued placeholder and grouped controls on a distinct white input surface.
760 dark composer fits Bot placeholder and all bottom controls; send has a filled circular treatment.
760 light multiline composer scrolls long text inside the input while plus/model/effort/send remain fixed beneath it.
Attached-image composer contains a rectangular thumbnail and explicit remove action above text, leaving a readable control row.
Dark Bot reply embeds the user quote horizontally at the top; body/list remain inside one tinted bubble and Details follows its edge.
Light reply embeds the same quote without a vertical stripe; selected Details focus is outside the bubble at its right edge.
760 quote draft keeps existing draft text beneath a removable source reference, with all send controls inside the composer.
760 sent quote is embedded inside the right user message; one receipt and one related Bot reply remain distinct.
Purple identity yields a softly purple Bot bubble and avatar; quoted content is integrated without a detached tiny card.
Purple light reply uses a pale identity tint with readable quote/source label and two-list body, without a stripe.
Pink dark reply tint matches the avatar; quote and body remain legible against the muted background.
Pink light reply keeps a restrained pink background and dark text rather than a saturated solid panel.
Green dark reply has the same compact geometry with green tint and readable source/navigation text.
Green light reply uses a pale green identity surface while retaining neutral surrounding chat background.
1280 dark sent quote is inside the user bubble above new text; receipt belongs to that same message.
1280 light sent quote keeps the embedded reference horizontally contained and separates the following Bot reply.
1280 dark familiarity reply embeds the brief user quote within the main tinted bubble; four findings and memory question fit.
1280 light familiarity reply keeps the source row within the bubble and retains paragraph/list separation and a following failure state.
760 dark short quote and long Bot report wrap naturally within the same bubble, with no detached tiny source block.
760 light quote and four-item report remain inside the narrow tinted reply; retry for the separate unfinished turn remains visible.
Selection quote action floats beside the selected text within the message instead of appearing below the entire reply.
Narrow selection quote action stays near selected text and leaves the existing composer draft visible.
With settings docked, selection quote action remains within the message; draft and settings controls retain their layout.
Completion card explains that a report has been generated, links the report and exposes a concrete confirmation action separate from task status.
Report opens in a separate right panel, with full findings and file evidence; close is reachable by keyboard.
Light narrow completion card keeps report and confirmation actions inside the card, with a visible keyboard focus ring.
Dark process drawer shows less-than-one-second and two-second timings, plus an unavailable timing without inventing zero.
Light narrow process drawer uses the same three timing meanings and retains a compact readable process list.
Budget exhaustion is stated in a normal Bot bubble with a continue action; provider diagnostics are not mixed into the public copy.
Light narrow budget warning wraps within the bubble and keeps its continue action separate from the composer.
Dark manual wake shows preserved progress, a follow-up card and retry narration; active processing has a compact status.
Light manual wake preserves the same task and retry narration; the action and composer remain within the narrow column.
Missing recovery record is visible in a normal dark Bot bubble with no blind replay action; retained narration beneath has a clear 8px gap.
At 760px the missing-record message wraps within its light bubble; the visible detail action stays at that bubble edge and retained narration is separated.
Scheduled recovery visibly says the connection was interrupted and progress will continue; prior narration is retained in separate spaced bubbles.
Light narrow scheduled recovery shows both retained narration bubbles and continuation text; detail action remains below the corresponding bubble edge.
Dark exhausted recovery states the connection has not recovered, preserves progress, and exposes an explicit continue action.
Light exhausted recovery wraps clearly; retained narration and the continue action have distinct spacing.
Dark authentication failure asks for login or connection configuration before continuing; no raw HTTP error is shown publicly.
Light authentication failure wraps within the bubble and retains the continue action beneath it.
Unknown operation result is stated as requiring verification with preserved progress; that message offers no blind replay action.
Light unknown-result message has no retry action and keeps both uncertainty and retained progress in plain copy.
Resolved interruption is visibly subdued and points to the latest reply; the resolved bubble has no retry action.
Light resolved message remains readable and separate from the latest ordinary reply and active task strip.
Verifying task strip and its right drawer agree on the current verification phase and offer cancellation.
Pending reply has a readable progress status at the left and a detail action at the bubble edge; drawer explains preparation.
Dark idle reply hides the detail action without removing its layout space; question choices remain readable.
Dark actual hover reveals the detail action below the short question at the bubble edge, not the full column edge.
Light idle reply keeps the detail action quiet and retains stable question and choice positioning.
Light actual hover reveals the short question detail action at its right edge with no competing status text.

findings.description: Earlier rejected capture happened before drawer resizing settled. The new capture waits for visible finite animations and checks text hit visibility after screenshot; actual target narration is visible in both themes.
Native transparent window background is absent from PNG capture; these images verify control layout, not OS-background contrast.
